result.summary: The page looks generally functional with no critical visual breakages. One minor truncation issue was found in the restaurant name display.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated without an ellipsis indicator, making it unclear that the name continues. The text is cut off abruptly at the card boundary.
issues.suggestion: Apply CSS text-overflow: ellipsis with overflow: hidden and a max-width constraint to ensure truncated text ends with '...' to signal the name is incomplete.
